title: CyberAlchemy Governance Model
objective: Document a typed Governance Model, preserve governance structure while repository-owned governance remains observe-only, and model one assessment vertical without giving the ontology enforcement or decision authority.

primary_units.label: Observe-Only Substrate
primary_units.responsibility: Declare and resolve the non-blocking effect of repository-owned governance adapters.

primary_units.label: First Governance Model Vertical
primary_units.responsibility: Assess one source-owned governance rule and route a non-binding recommendation.

facts.statement: Observe-only findings cannot block, mutate, promote, request, authorize, or transition lifecycle.
Ordinary work commands remain independent of governance observers; optional observation occurs beside or after the work result.
Repository posture and Governance Assessment are coordinated units, not one aggregate.
The governance ontology owns external product bindings; the closed product ontology registries remain unchanged.
Semantic identity, lifecycle state, reference currentness, authority state, product contribution, and observation evidence remain orthogonal.
A Governance Assessment can recommend but cannot create a Governance Decision or change a rule.
The superproject contains seven independent Git roots plus external CI state; no current single flag establishes whole-repository deactivation.
A whole-package or whole-repository digest is validation snapshot evidence only and never a semantic or lifecycle clock.

normal_invoke_design_admission.reason: No admitted Define v3 stage and admission chain exists for this target.

claim_ceiling: Discovery Design structure and ontology seed only; the companion CAV2-D58 Definition repair is separately scoped. No enforcement deactivation, implementation readiness, Constitution activation, publication, deployment, or product proof.
